description.text: Grants [Twin Element Mode (Wind, Dark)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Estinien], [Apex Azure Dragoon Damage Tracker] and [Apex Azure Dragoon Level]

description.name: Twin Element Mode (Wind, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Wind]/[Attach Dark] after using a Wind/Dark ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Estinien
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Azure Dragoon (0~2), removed after using Apex Azure Dragoon two times

description.name: Apex Azure Dragoon Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Azure Dragoon level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Estinien]

description.name: Apex Azure Dragoon Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Azure Dragoon level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Estinien]
